errors.text_span: five different models—labeled Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber, and Forget Set
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 'Forget Set' as a fifth model. The legend shows that 'Forget Set' is a diagonal hatching pattern applied to bars of other models (RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber) to signify a specific condition, not a separate model category.

errors.text_span: The bars are arranged in a consistent left-to-right order across all three charts, corresponding to the dataset labels on the x-axis.
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous and structurally incorrect. The dataset labels on the x-axis (WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, WMDP-Cyber) define the three main groups of bars, not the arrangement of individual bars within the groups.

errors.text_span: with the highest values observed in the CHOOSE task for the Base model and the lowest in the GENERATE task for the RMU model on WMDP-Bio. The success rates for the NPO-Bio and NPO-Cyber models are generally higher than those of the RMU model in the GENERATE task, while the Forget Set model consistently shows the lowest success rates across all tasks and datasets.
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly forbids making comparisons ('не сравнявайте стойности'). This part of the description contains multiple comparisons and interpretations ('highest', 'lowest', 'higher than', 'consistently shows the lowest'), which violates a core instruction of the prompt.

errors.text_span: while the Forget Set model consistently shows the lowest success rates across all tasks and datasets.
errors.evidence: This statement is based on the incorrect premise that 'Forget Set' is a model. Furthermore, the claim itself is not consistently true. For example, in the GENERATE task for WMDP-Bio, the hatched NPO-Bio bar (0.43) is higher than both the Base (0.31) and NPO-Cyber (0.42) bars.

errors.text_span: no visual emphasis such as highlighting or shading is applied to any particular bar.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The diagonal hatching pattern ('Forget Set') is a form of visual emphasis (shading/patterning) used to distinguish a subset of the bars, as clearly indicated by the legend.

errors.text_span: verschiedener Modelle – Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber und Forget Set
errors.evidence: "Forget Set" is not a model, but a visual pattern (diagonal stripes) applied to bars of other models to highlight them. The legend shows it as a pattern, and the chart applies this pattern to some of the four model bars (Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber) within each group. The description incorrectly lists it as a fifth, separate model.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse zeigt die Kategorien der Datensätze, jeweils gruppiert nach der Aufgabe
errors.evidence: The structure is misunderstood. The figure contains three separate charts, with each chart representing one task. Within each chart, the x-axis categories are the datasets (WMDP-Bio, WMDP-Chem, WMDP-Cyber). The datasets are not grouped by task on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: Die Balken in jedem Diagramm sind in der Reihenfolge der Modelle in der Legende angeordnet, beginnend mit Base, gefolgt von RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber und Forget Set.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly states there are five bars per group, including one for "Forget Set". Each group only contains four bars for the four models (Base, RMU, NPO-Bio, NPO-Cyber). There is no fifth bar for "Forget Set".
